basics.description:
Deploys the **Microsoft Security Logging Guide** Microsoft Sentinel Content Hub V3 solution into an existing Sentinel-enabled Log Analytics workspace.

**Analytic Rules:** 122, **Hunting Queries:** 22, **Workbooks:** 2

[View guide and source KQL](https://github.com/jusso-dev/microsoft-security-logging-guide)

metadata.hidden: Location is derived from the selected Log Analytics workspace.

basics.name: getLAWorkspace
basics.toolTip: Lists Log Analytics workspaces in the selected resource group.

basics.name: workspace
basics.label: Workspace
basics.toolTip: Select the Log Analytics workspace where Microsoft Sentinel is enabled.

elements.name: DeployAnalyticsRule
elements.label: Deploy Analytic Rule templates (122)
elements.toolTip: Installs all custom detection rule templates into Microsoft Sentinel Analytics Rule Templates (disabled by default until you enable and tune them).

elements.name: DeployHuntingQuery
elements.label: Deploy Hunting Queries (22)
elements.toolTip: Installs hunting queries from the product guides and operational packs.

elements.name: DeployWorkbook
elements.label: Deploy Workbooks (2)
elements.toolTip: Installs the Ingestion Health and Cost Estimation workbook templates.

elements.name: workbook1-name
elements.label: Ingestion Health workbook name
elements.defaultValue: Microsoft Security Logging Guide - Ingestion Health and Table Freshness
elements.toolTip: Display name for the Ingestion Health and Table Freshness workbook.

elements.name: workbook2-name
elements.label: Cost Estimation workbook name
elements.defaultValue: Microsoft Security Logging Guide - Cost Estimation and Volume Monitoring
elements.toolTip: Display name for the Cost Estimation and Volume Monitoring workbook.
